card.name: Decimal point in ultrasound contrast labels
card.fires_on: The decimal point or space right before a number like 0.8 or 0.4 in mechanical index limits for ultrasound contrast agents. It also fires weakly on other spots in the same labels, such as 'of' before sulfur hexafluoride.
